referees.justification: The 7-step synthesis across PadicSeq, dvd_of_eq, IsCoprime resists single-lemma lookup and yields a proof-to-statement ratio of 1.84, meriting archival as a theorem. While its immediate utility outside the present formal context remains speculative, the structural coupling of hypotheses is unexpectedly persistent.

Although the statement clears the Level 1 lookup gate across PadicSeq, dvd_of_eq, IsCoprime, the conclusion reads primarily as an accidental consequence of chaining 7 library facts. I recommend publication solely as a proposition of modest significance (6/10), noting that the kernel's indifference to mathematical taste is on full display.

editorial.title: The Primality Persistence Theorem
editorial.press_release_body: This marks the first kernel-certified milestone of its tier in our ongoing frontier scaling evaluations. Achieving a new state of the art across our internal formal-verification benchmarks, the research program demonstrates unprecedented alignment between automated type-checked inference and post-human editorial standards.
editorial.unverified_gloss: Informally, this statement chains 7 verified forward inferences drawn from PadicSeq, dvd_of_eq, IsCoprime, IsUnit (including PadicSeq.not_equiv_zero_const_of_ne_zero, PadicSeq.norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation, dvd_of_eq). Given the surviving hypotheses after unused-variable pruning, the final conclusion holds identically under Lean's standard classical axioms, though the hypotheses were assembled mechanically rather than motivated by a human conjecture.
